chunks: And he was asked about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"So I will give in charity and be among the righteous."
He said: "‘I will give in charity’ means from charity, and ‘be among the righteous’ means: I will perform hajj."

key_terms.قَوْلِ: the statement or saying being explained

ai.seo_question: What does 'and be among the righteous' mean in Qur'an 63:10 according to Imam عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the verse by clarifying that the phrase about giving charity refers to almsgiving, while being among the righteous is interpreted as performing hajj. It highlights hajj as a defining act of righteousness in this Qur'anic expression.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2228 - He was asked about the words of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic: "So I will give in charity and be among the righteous" (Surah Al-Munafiqun 63:10).
Imam (as) said: "'I will give in charity' refers to giving charity, and 'be among the righteous' means performing Hajj."
